title: Recording: I Don’t Wanna Face It, Walking On Thin Ice, (Forgive Me) My Little Flower Princess by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

The seventh recording session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 14 August 1980.

Three tracks were worked on, none of which were included on the album. The first was Lennon’s ‘I Don’t Wanna Face It’, which remained unreleased until 1984’s Milk And Honey.

The next song was Ono’s ‘Walking On Thin Ice’, which was released as a single in 1981. Following the completion of the backing track, Lennon was recorded telling her: “I think you just cut your first number one, Yoko.”

The final song to be tackled was ‘(Forgive Me) My Little Flower Princess’, another Lennon track which was held back until Milk And Honey.
